question: A question about Anime Season 4. I believe Anastasia was split in half several times, but which Anastasia is your favorite?
answer:
I guess Episode 3 (Episode 69 overall), right? (laughs) The one where she goes BAM! right in front of Subaru. Honestly, I was wondering how they were going to do that—whether they'd use all sorts of techniques to make sure you couldn't see too much—but then I thought, “Ah, I see. So this is how they can get away with showing it these days.”

I also like the part where Subaru comes up the spiral staircase absolutely brimming with murderous intent, and Anastasia is hanging upside down on the stairs. She has this sort of utterly indifferent look on her face... I'm starting to sound like a really messed-up person, aren't I? (laughs)
